prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic view of a modern car’s digital dashboard display, focusing on a high-resolution screen. The interface is sleek and minimalistic, with a sidebar menu on the left featuring icons for Home, Google Assistant, Maps, Smartphone Projection, and Settings, all rendered in a cool blue and white color scheme. The main section of the screen displays a dynamic, stylized image of a car’s rear wheel in motion, partially visible on the right side, with dramatic motion blur. Vivid red and orange light trails streak diagonally across a dark background, evoking a sense of speed and energy, while the word “SPORT” is prominently displayed in the upper left, suggesting a performance driving mode. The time “20:45” is shown in the upper right in a clean, modern font. The overall color palette is dominated by deep reds, oranges, and blacks, contrasted with the cool blue of the interface. The lighting is high-contrast and glossy, with a futuristic, high-tech aesthetic. The composition is tight and immersive, as if viewed from the driver’s perspective, emphasizing the excitement and advanced technology of the vehicle.
